description: Under heavy CPU load (a render) the tracker only manages a sample every 5 s, then every 4 s: every gap is within maxGap (15 s) and the clocks agree, so all of it is credited. In between, the tracker thread hangs for 20 s: both clocks agree but the gap exceeds maxGap, so the interval ends at the last sample before the hang (time gap) and the 20 s are not credited. The probe reports raw idle milliseconds here instead of a last-input time.
